audit.proof_assessment: Static review of the allowlisted route slice only; disposition/pass claims were not re-executed. R-07 is closed in production: unauthorized/invalid-run/invalid-assignment helpers and GET/POST success all emit Cache-Control no-store, with 403 and POST 400 assertions added. R-08 is closed: afterEach calls vi.restoreAllMocks before unstubAllGlobals, and the producer test immediately after the Date.now collision spy asserts Date.now() is not 1788080000000, which fails if that spy leaked. R-05 is encoded as a deterministic 2000-NUL seven-key POST: HTTP 200, no-store, exact five-key envelope via Object.keys, proposal toBeNull, budget-exhausted/input-bytes-exceeded, null output hashes. 2000 NULs remain schema-valid under trim/max(2000) while canonical JSON \u0000 escaping is ~12KiB, above maxInputBytes 8192, so the budget expectation is consistent with a canonical-JSON byte check. T3A mapping, auth-before-body, strict seven-key assignment, HTTP runId echo, and local producer are unchanged.
residual_risks: Executor input-byte accounting and receipt shape live outside the slice; the 2000-NUL case is only proven if executeAiTeammateJobV1 measures escaped canonical bytes.
Receipt assertions use toMatchObject, so extra receipt keys would not fail.
Complete-path POST 200 and leading-symbol 200 tests still omit cache-control; GET 400 has no dedicated header case (shared helper).
